culture.text: Runs 13-month programmes where data and AI professionals work at a client while training, then can join the client as medior or senior.
Participants need 3-4 years of relevant work experience before joining.
Part of the Xebia Group, based in Amsterdam, about 38 people on LinkedIn; top schools include University of Amsterdam and TU Eindhoven.
